description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) script that sets up build configuration for the 'byacc' parser generator within a Yocto/OpenEmbedded build environment. It defines metadata, source URLs, patches, configuration options, and inheritance for building the 'byacc' package.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Custom configuration step that installs config.guess and config.sub scripts and runs the configure process via oe_runconf.
